subject: MAP & contracting: procurement/legal handoff for SageMed evaluation
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Briggs <e.briggs@sagemed.com>, procurement@sagemed.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff & contracting handoff for SageMed evaluation

Eleanor / SageMed procurement team —

Thanks for the time on the product review yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m kicking off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on evaluation milestones, contracting owners, and an expected close window. Attached is a first-pass MAP and the SOW draft for your legal to reference.

High-level proposal (suggested dates):
- Evaluation sandbox + POC: 11/29 — 12/10
- Initial redlines & legal review: by 12/04
- Final commercial terms & signatures: target 12/17

Proposed roles (RACI):
- Redwood: Naomi (AM) — overall MAP owner; Marissa (CS) — POC/implementation lead; Jordan (solutions) — pricing/ops; Karthik (legal liaison) — contracting owner from our side.
- SageMed: please confirm procurement and legal owners (I’ve copied procurement@ and would appreciate a direct contact).

As next steps, can you: 1) confirm the legal/terms owner, 2) confirm the target for initial redlines (we proposed 12/04), and 3) share any supplier paperwork we should complete? I’ll set up a short 30-minute contracting touchpoint once we have the owner.

Attachments: SageMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP template), SageMed_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW draft)

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Eleanor Briggs <e.briggs@sagemed.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@sagemed.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & contracting handoff for SageMed evaluation

Hi Naomi —

Thanks, and appreciate the clear MAP. Quick notes from procurement:
- Procurement owner: Tom Harrington (legal) — I’ve cc’d him directly on this thread. He’ll coordinate the SOW review and supplier paperwork.
- Timeline: we can aim to have initial redlines to you by EOD 12/04. We’ll try to accelerate if the SOW is straightforward.
- Supplier forms: attaching our vendor compliance spreadsheet; please complete and return by 12/02 so we can ingest vendor details.

I’ll let Tom speak to specific legal terms, but we are generally focused on: data residency clauses, indemnity cap, and SLA commitments.

Best,
Eleanor Briggs
Head of Strategic Procurement | SageMed Systems
e.briggs@sagemed.com
Attachment: vendor_compliance_form.csv

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harrington <tom.harrington@legal.sagemed.com>, Eleanor Briggs <e.briggs@sagemed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & contracting handoff for SageMed evaluation

Tom / Eleanor — great, thanks for the quick reply and the vendor form. Tom, welcome — glad to have you looped in.

To make redlines efficient on both sides, our suggested process is:
1) You mark up the attached SOW draft (tracked changes) and return by 12/04.
2) Karthik will review the redline and respond with our proposed counter-markup within 48 business hours.
3) If there are commercial points that need escalation (caps, indemnity, SLA), we can set a single 30-minute call to resolve — suggested window 12/06–12/08.

We can use the HubSpot deal record (link below) to exchange docs and keep versions. If you prefer Share or a DocuSign redline flow, we’re happy to adapt — whichever is easiest for your legal team.

I’ve attached a short redline guidance doc to help speed review (what we typically accept vs. require escalation).

Related links: https://hubspot.example/deal/SM-2026-7891
Attachments: redline_guidance.docx

Thanks,
Naomi

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harrington <tom.harrington@legal.sagemed.com>, Eleanor Briggs <e.briggs@sagemed.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & contracting handoff for SageMed evaluation

Tom / team —

I’ll be the contracting/terms owner from Redwood on this deal and will coordinate redlines. Quick notes from our side:
- Please include our standard DPA (we can provide a one-page addendum) — if you have an existing MD/DP template, send it and we’ll map differences.
- SLA: we can commit to the performance targets in the SOW; if you need a formal SLA addendum, we can produce one within 48 hours after agreement on metrics.
- Indemnity & liability: we tend to keep liability caps to a multiple of annual recurring revenue; I’ll mark the acceptable range in my counter-redline.

Proposed short call: Wed, Dec 1 @ 3pm PT (30 min) to sync on any sticking points before redlines go back and forth. Naomi — can you send calendar invite?

Attachment: redline-guidance.docx

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal & Contracts (Liaison) | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Tom Harrington <tom.harrington@legal.sagemed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & contracting handoff for SageMed evaluation

Karthik / Naomi / team —

Thanks — I can confirm I’ll take the SOW and circulate an initial mark-up by EOD 12/04. Wed 12/01 @ 3pm PT works for a short sync; I’ll accept the calendar invite.

A few immediate asks to keep things moving:
- Could you provide a short note on sandbox access (IP allowlist + point of contact) so our security team can start onboarding?
- I’ll upload our initial comments to the DocHub link once available and flag any truly material changes.

We expect to aim for signatures by 12/17 if there are no major open commercial items. Appreciate the clear MAP — should make the process straightforward.

Tom Harrington
Senior Counsel | SageMed Systems
tom.harrington@legal.sagemed.com
